| Case | Measurements | Seconds |
|---|---:|---:|
| Baseline geometric | 1,431 | 37.62 |
| Inner32 geometric | 1,438 | 41.94 |

| Inner-family geometric, final source | 1,453 | 42.45 |
| Mild added-disc development control | 1,482 | 42.94 |

The coverage candidate has 46,042 sensitive surfaces, 54 logical layers and 67 material carriers. Its two added homogeneous carriers are downstream at z≈±1006.825 mm. No-op compact bytes, material JSON and calibration JSON match the reference exactly. For 100 geometric events, all 31 particle, 99 track-summary and 42 measurement branches match PR101 exactly.

**Validation:** task-local native helper built successfully; combined activated suite **17/17 passed, no skips**; session validation passed for 209 records.

- `software/running/nodd_tracker_optimization.py`

```sh
python -B software/running/nodd_tracker_optimization.py \

```
